title: Neuropsychological Practice Leader:- BH
description:
Neuropsychological Practice Leader:
 
If you are an experienced clinical leader with a passion for advancing neuropsychological services and fostering hope through innovative mental health care — read on...
 
Neuropsychological Practice Leader Opportunity Description:
A well-established behavioral health organization, in the Greater WI area, is seeking a Neuropsychological Practice Leader (NPL) to guide and strengthen neuropsychological services across residential and outpatient programs. The role blends leadership and clinical practice, offering the opportunity to shape program development while maintaining a hands-on connection with clients through evaluation and consultation.
The NPL will provide supervision, mentorship, and clinical oversight to a team of psychologists and interns, while collaborating with multidisciplinary staff to ensure exceptional, evidence-based care. This position is ideal for a licensed psychologist who thrives in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment.
 
Neuropsychological Practice Leader Job Requirements:
  • Doctoral degree from an APA-accredited program in Clinical Psychology
  • Licensed (or eligible for licensure) in the State of Wisconsin
  • Internship and fellowship training in pediatric neuropsychology
  • Minimum 5 years of post-licensure clinical experience
  • Strong leadership, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
  •  
Neuropsychological Practice Leader Job Responsibilities:
  • Lead and oversee all neuropsychological services across clinical programs
  • Provide supervision, training, and mentorship to psychologists and clinical interns
  • Conduct comprehensive neuropsychological evaluations and consultations
  • Collaborate with program leadership to develop and evaluate evidence-based practices
  • Promote an inclusive, supportive, and interdisciplinary clinical culture
  • Ensure compliance with ethical and professional standards
 
 The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. Our client does offer a competitive compensation package potentially including incentives, health insurance, PTO, retirement plans (401K), opportunities for professional development, tuition reimbursement and potential sign on bonus.
